stem: What is the most likely reason the poet uses personification throughout the poem?

options.label: F
options.text: To compare March’s behavior to that of an impatient person

options.label: G
options.text: To produce a personal reaction of sadness for March’s farewell

options.label: H
options.text: To show how March’s changing of the seasons may affect each person

options.label: J
options.text: To use the actions of a person to describe March’s effect on the weather
